findings.summary: initialState is assigned the Flow itself, not its first emitted value, so the null check never triggers onboarding.
findings.mechanism: `programStateRepo.observe(program.id)` returns `Flow<ProgramState?>`. The diff assigns this Flow object directly to `initialState` instead of calling `.first()` on it (the `first` import is added but never used). A Flow reference is never null, so `if (initialState == null)` is always false and startDestination always resolves to TopLevelRoute.Main — onboarding is never shown, even on first launch with no program state.
